SELECT APPLY_PARAM_NO, REFERENCN_FLAG, REFERENCN_FROM_FLAG, REFERENCN_FROM_OFFSET, REFERENCN_FROM_RELATION, REFERENCN_TO_FLAG, REFERENCN_TO_OFFSET, REFERENCN_TO_RELATION, APPLY_TYPE, AFFIRM_LEVEL, ESS.ACTIVITY, EMP_TYPE, DECODE(EMP_TYPE,'Q','全部','G','管理职','其他') EMP_TYPE_NAME, DUTY_NO, DECODE(DUTY_NO,'Q','全部',GET_GLOBAL_NAME(DUTY_NO,'zh')) DUTY_NAME, GET_CODE_NAME(ESS.APPLY_TYPE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) APPLY_NAME, TO_CHAR(ESS.CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATE_DATE, ESS.CREATED_BY, TO_CHAR(ESS.UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS UPDATE_DATE, ESS.UPDATED_BY, (SELECT GET_GLOBAL_NAME( DUTY,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) FROM SY_AFFIRM_LEVEL_SETUP WHERE AFFIRM_LEVEL = LOW_LEVEL AND CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR#) LOW_LEVEL, (SELECT GET_GLOBAL_NAME( DUTY,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) FROM SY_AFFIRM_LEVEL_SETUP WHERE AFFIRM_LEVEL = HIGH_LEVEL AND CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# ) HIGH_LEVEL FROM ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_PARAM ESS WHERE ESS.CPNY_ID=#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#
APPLY_TYPE = #APPLY_TYPE:VARCHAR#
TYPE = 'ar'
TYPE = 'pa'
APPLY_PARAM_NO = #APPLY_PARAM_NO:NUMERIC#
ORDER BY APPLY_TYPE,APPLY_PARAM_NO

SELECT count(*) FROM ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_PARAM ESS, SY_CODE SY, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SG WHERE SG.NO(+) = SY.CODE_NO AND SG.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND ESS.APPLY_TYPE = SY.CODE_NO(+) AND ESS.CPNY_ID=#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#
APPLY_TYPE = #APPLY_TYPE:VARCHAR#
TYPE = 'ar'

APPLY_PARAM_NO = #APPLY_PARAM_NO:NUMERIC#

SELECT A.CODE_NO AS CODE_NO, S.CONTENT AS CODENAME FROM SY_CODE A, SY_CODE_PARAM SC, SY_GLOBAL_NAME S WHERE EXISTS (SELECT C.CODE_NO FROM SY_CODE C, SY_CODE_PARAM P WHERE C.PARENT_CODE_NO = 16413 AND C.CODE_NO = P.CODE_NO AND P.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND C.ACTIVITY=1 AND C.CODE_NO = A.PARENT_CODE_NO) AND A.CODE_NO = S.NO(+) AND S.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND SC.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND A.CODE_NO = SC.CODE_NO AND A.ACTIVITY=1 ORDER BY A.PARENT_CODE_NO,A.ORDERNO

SELECT DISTINCT( S.DUTY_NO), SG.CONTENT AS POSTNAME, S.ORDERNO FROM SY_AFFIRMOR_LIST S, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SG, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HD WHERE S.DUTY_NO = SG.NO(+) AND SG.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND S.DEPT_NO = HD.DEPTNO(+) AND HD.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND S.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# ORDER BY S.ORDERNO
SELECT T.DUTY_NO,SG.CONTENT DUTYNAME FROM HR_DUTY T, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SG WHERE T.DUTY_NO = SG.NO(+) AND SG.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND CPNY_ID =#interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND T.ACTIVITY=1
